runtime_helper.contract: Create a fresh two-line Semgrep version cache containing the current integer timestamp and an empty JSON mapping; require an existing parent and refuse overwrite.

unchanged_scope.source_and_training_contract: The original 138-label training cutoff and digest, exact Actual, Memos, and Authentik commits, six-eligible-identities-per-family contract, resource ceilings, four allowed hosts, prediction-only boundary, and every outcome exclusion remain unchanged.

retained_failed_artifact.immutability: Retain the stopped retry log unchanged. The runtime-corrected retry uses a new artifact directory and may not overwrite or delete this evidence.

corrected_runtime.requirement: Create the new artifact directory, seed and verify the fresh workspace cache, and import-check the installed version without starting the Semgrep CLI. Prefix both exact Semgrep path variables on every later process that can invoke Semgrep.

separated_preflight.offline_command: SEMGREP_LOG_FILE=data/artifacts/opt003-wave-2-runtime-retry/semgrep.log SEMGREP_VERSION_CACHE_PATH=data/artifacts/opt003-wave-2-runtime-retry/semgrep-version-cache uv run repoauditor scanner-canaries --scanner semgrep --scanner semgrep-supplemental --scanner gitleaks --output data/artifacts/opt003-wave-2-runtime-retry/offline-canaries.json
separated_preflight.advisory_command: SEMGREP_LOG_FILE=data/artifacts/opt003-wave-2-runtime-retry/semgrep.log SEMGREP_VERSION_CACHE_PATH=data/artifacts/opt003-wave-2-runtime-retry/semgrep-version-cache uv run repoauditor scanner-canaries --scanner pip-audit --scanner osv-scanner --output data/artifacts/opt003-wave-2-runtime-retry/advisory-canaries.json
separated_preflight.ordering: The helper digest, imported version, fresh local cache, and both separated reports must pass before the new wave-two model is trained or any source is materialized.

retry_sequence: Verify all receipt, stopped-attempt, helper, retained-log, byte-identical store, 138-label corpus, exact-source, and absent new-artifact identities.
Create only data/artifacts/opt003-wave-2-runtime-retry; do not delete or overwrite retained failure evidence.
Run the version import command, require exactly 1.170.0, then seed and parse-check the fresh workspace version cache before starting any Semgrep CLI process.
Run the explicitly filtered offline canaries with both exact Semgrep path variables and require zero network reads.
Only after offline success, run the separately explicit advisory canaries against the three named advisory hosts with the same two path variables.
Only after both reports pass, train and freeze one new model from the unchanged 138-label cutoff before materializing any source.
Materialize and process the three original exact source commits in original order, prefixing both exact Semgrep path variables on every detection process.

Persist compatible predictions, verify at least six eligible production or deployment identities per family, write one immutable retry result, and stop before packet selection or candidate disclosure.
stop_conditions: Any prior receipt, stopped-attempt, helper, retained-log, store, training-corpus, source, commit, family, budget, host, inventory, or prediction-only identity drifts.

The new artifact directory is not absent initially, retained failure evidence is changed, the helper overwrites a cache, or either Semgrep path variable is absent or differs on any Semgrep-capable process.
The import-only version command starts the Semgrep CLI, writes any file, contacts any host, or does not report exactly 1.170.0.
The fresh local cache is malformed, stale, outside the new artifact directory, or Semgrep reads or writes any other version cache.
Any process contacts semgrep.dev or another host outside github.com, pypi.org, api.osv.dev, and osv.dev.
Either separated canary report fails or contains a scanner not explicitly named by its command.
Any model is trained before all runtime and canary checks pass, any prior-attempt model is reused, or any source or scoring identity drifts.

Any provider, packet selection, candidate identity disclosure for review, source rendering, human outcome, assessment, label, rescore, tuning, recalibration, threshold selection, production-policy change, or OPT-003 closure is attempted.
Any family yields fewer than six eligible production or deployment identities; retain completed prediction evidence and report the inventory shortfall, but do not propose or execute packet selection.
result_boundary: A separate runtime-corrected result must prove the local version import, cache and log confinement, separated canary membership and health, allowed-host accounting, one new model, exact sources, prediction chronology, aggregate eligible inventories, and zero outcomes before any packet-selection receipt.
